label: Add glasses · Qwen Image 2.1
blurb: Puts glasses or sunglasses on the person in Image 1.
source: ComfyUI template image_qwen_image_2_1_image_edit (prompt enhancer left out)
tips: Give the shape, color and material of the frames.

inputs.label: Person
inputs.hint: Face clearly visible, looking roughly at the camera.

inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.default: Put glasses on the person in <image1>. The glasses: round tortoiseshell frames. They sit naturally on the nose and ears at the right scale, with realistic lens reflections and shadows. Keep the face, identity, eyes, expression, hair, pose, clothing, lighting, framing and background exactly as they are.
